ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.17.2 extends the bounded-risk parallel Work prefilter compatibility layer for the tested large mod environment. Humanoid Alien Races GrowerHarvest remains source-reviewed as downstream true-to-false authority. GrowerSow now supports exact Biomes! Core and ReGrowth Core JobOnCell season-context patches in restricted mode: workers do not execute PlantUtility.GrowthSeasonNow at all for Sow classification, avoiding Biomes/ReGrowth shared-static or main-thread-maintained season state while retaining safe NoDesiredPlant and SameDesiredPlantPresent hard negatives. Live Vanilla JobOnCell remains authoritative for all growth-season decisions. Watchtowers BuildRoof remains fail-closed pending source review. Workers never create Jobs, reserve targets or mutate Pawn/Thing/Map state. V0.4.16 aggressive Reachability, Harmony census, persistent map search, hauling accelerators, path shadow validation and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
